reference_method.centering: difference minus observed mean; boundary hurdle zero
reference_method.confidence_interval: Marginal bootstrap-t, linear 2.5/97.5 percentiles, inverted with observed HAC SE
reference_method.degenerate_policy: All5000 reference draws retained; any SE<=1e-15 makes p/CI null and the whole diagnostic inconclusive
reference_method.hac: Bartlett taper; lag=max(1,floor(4*(n/100)^(2/9))); every autocovariance denominator n
reference_method.normal_tail_and_mde: stdlib erfc and NormalDist; no production/scipy evaluator imported

scope: Numerical reproduction of eight pre-existing exploratory rank contrasts only; no new hypotheses, winner selection, economic confirmation or stationarity validation.
